title: Symmetric edge polytopes are not gamma-positive
summary: A conjecture posed by Ohsugi and Tsuchiya (2019) postulates that the Ehrhart $h^*$-polynomials of symmetric edge polytopes are $γ$-positive. We disprove this conjecture by exhibiting an infinite family of counterexamples. The smallest example provided by our construction is a $36$-dimensional symmetric edge polytope.
